answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after months of peer-attested work. On that long horizon, spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes too expensive to sustain, like trying to farm a barren tundra that yields nothing unless you actually stay and keep working. Every verified task then sends a small ripple of credit to the bonded identity, while unused clones quietly forfeit their deposits.
